src: APPSC Fisheries Development Officer, Sericulture Officer, Ag
s: In January 2022, the Andhra Pradesh government announced an increase in the retirement age for its employees from 60 to ____ years.
x: On 7 Jan 2022 AP announced the 11th PRC (23% fitment) and raised the retirement age of state employees from 60 to 62; the ordinance amending the AP Public Employment (Regulation of Age of Superannuation) Act took effect from 1 Jan 2022.

s: Which of the following is NOT authorised to use Andhra Pradesh Government State Emblem?

x: Under the AP State emblem order of 14 Nov 2018 the multi-colour emblem may be used by the CM, Ministers, Chief Secretary, Secretaries to Government, the Advocate General, all Heads of Departments and Collectors; heads of autonomous bodies are not among the authorised users.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: Who among the following is NOT a Deputy Chief Minister in the present Andhra Pradesh Government?
x:
the 2019 YSRCP cabinet and its five Deputy CMs changed (Dharmana Krishna Das became Deputy CM in July 2020; the cabinet was reshuffled in April 2022 and replaced in June 2024) — now Pawan Kalyan is the sole Deputy CM of AP (since 12 June 2024; general knowledge, not checked)
When this was asked, Jagan Mohan Reddy's cabinet had five Deputy CMs – Pilli Subhash Chandra Bose, Alla Kali Krishna Srinivas (Alla Nani), K. Narayana Swamy, Pamula Pushpa Sreevani and Amzath Basha – so Dharmana Krishna Das (then R&B minister) was not one; he became Deputy CM only in July 2020 (now the only Deputy CM is Pawan Kalyan, since June 2024). (Off-topic; moved.)

s: How many sectoral missions are established by the Government of Andhra Pradesh as part of the mission based developmental strategy?
